title: BPM System 2026 — 三种时间的实时视觉演奏
titleEn: BPM System 2026 — A Performable Visual Time System
summary: 从 REACTOR Opening 的现场经验出发：三种时间、三轨透明度、MIDI/OSC 控制与灯光协作。配有可操作的图解和折叠式搭建手册。
summaryEn: A compact field essay on three kinds of time, layered opacity, MIDI/OSC control, and collaborative performance, using REACTOR Opening as a case study.
